tagline: World-class producer and exporter of high-quality, low-cost metallurgical and thermal coals
hero_kpi_rationale: Realized Coal Revenue ($4,164.8 M) is the key performance metric used by management to assess operational results and profitability, directly reflecting the quality and quantity of coal sold

kpis.name: Coal Production
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of coal produced by the company
kpis.description: Coal production is the company's primary product, including metallurgical and thermal coals

kpis.name: Coal Sales
kpis.explanation: Total volume of coal sold by the company
kpis.description: Coal sales volume comes from three operating segments: High CV Thermal (30.558 Mt), Metallurgical (9.038 Mt) and PRB (48.940 Mt)

kpis.name: Realized Coal Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from coal sales, adjusted to reflect quality and quantity
kpis.description: Realized Coal Revenue excludes transportation costs, transloading revenues, and other revenues not directly attributable to coal sales. This measure is preferred by management to evaluate operational performance
kpis.signal: Key non-GAAP performance metric used by management

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, value extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of €4.16 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Net income of -€0.15 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €6.13 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.45 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.43 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash Cost of Coal Sold
kpis.explanation: Direct production cost of sold coal per ton
kpis.description: Cash Cost of Coal Sold includes direct operating costs, royalties and production taxes, and direct administrative costs, excluding transportation costs and depreciation. Provided here for the High CV Thermal segment at $40.99/ton. Consolidated cost: $2,764.965 M for 88.536 Mt
kpis.signal: Key non-GAAP operational metric to assess production efficiency

kpis.short: Realized Coal Revenue per Ton Sold
kpis.name: Realized Coal Revenue per Ton Sold
kpis.explanation: Average revenue per ton of coal sold
kpis.description: Realized revenue per ton varies significantly by coal quality: Metallurgical (coking coal) $113.91/t, High CV Thermal $60.34/t, PRB $14.46/t. Consolidated average calculated: $3,476.341 M / 88.536 Mt = $39.26/t
kpis.signal: Indicator of realized pricing and coal quality

kpis.name: Cash Margin per Ton Sold
kpis.explanation: Gross operating margin per ton, defined as realized revenue minus cost of coal sold
kpis.description: Cash Margin per Ton (realized revenue per ton minus cash cost of coal sold per ton) is a key metric used by management to evaluate segment-level operational performance and profitability
kpis.signal: Key indicator of normalized operational profitability

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Economic Deterioration
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly states that deterioration in economic conditions in the industries where its customers operate could reduce demand for its products and impact its ability to collect customer payments. This is mentioned in multiple sections of the report, underscoring its critical importance.

risks.title: Coal Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Coal price volatility is cited as a key factor that could impact the company's operating results and cash flows. Coal prices are influenced by numerous factors, including supply and demand, weather conditions, and prices of alternative fuels.

risks.title: Customer Concentration Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company acknowledges it has customer concentration, meaning the loss or significant reduction in purchases by its largest customers could negatively impact its business, financial condition, operating results, and cash flows.

risks.title: Environmental and Climate Risks
risks.score_rationale: Environmental and climate regulations, as well as changes in government policies, could significantly impact the company's operating costs and the coal market. The company explicitly mentions risks related to pollution and climate change.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on suppliers for equipment and raw materials. Disruptions in the supply chain, including delays or shortages, could impact the company's ability to produce and deliver coal.

risks.title: Raw Material Price and Availability Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company uses significant quantities of raw materials, the price and availability of which may vary. Price increases or shortages of these materials could impact the company's operating costs.

risks.title: Export Customer Concentration Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant exposure to risks related to export customer concentration. Fluctuations in demand or prices in export markets could impact the company's sales and operating results.

ai_positioning.summary: The company CNR does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses primarily on financial statements, mining operations, and significant corporate events (merger with Arch, incident at Leer South, One Big Beautiful Bill Act), with no reference to AI or related technology.
